mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_link_device_stats ( full_short_url, gid, date, cnt, device, create_time, update_time, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{fullShortUrl}, #{gid}, #{date}, #{cnt}, #{device}, now(), now(), 0 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE cnt = cnt + #{cnt}, update_time = NOW();
mapper.select: select sum(cnt) as cnt,device from t_link_device_stats where full_short_url = #{fullShortUrl} and gid = #{gid} and date between #{start} and #{end} and del_flag = 0 group by device
